findings.finding: Can power SYS from battery while VIN remains connected and stop charging; potentially replace external USB suspend latch. Mode ignored below BUVLO, VIN reconnect resets mode.
Input current limit defaults to500mA, not100mA. External pre-enumeration protection cannot simply be deleted.
Default watchdog can restore register defaults. Review firmware hang/reset together with hardware USB and charging limits.
Termination selectable5/10/20 percent of charge current. Exact selected settings and low-current tolerance still require analysis against battery1.1mA reference.

startup_review.hardware_CE: Pin4 active-low, internal approximately5Mohm pulldown. Must be pulled high externally until configuration and temperature checks pass. Floating pin enables charging.
startup_review.critical_reset_case: MCU remains running with CE low while PMIC watchdog restores4.2V/500mA defaults. MCU reset pulldown alone does not prevent this. Do not claim hardware-safe4.1V charge from an I2C setting.
startup_review.voltage_decision: Retain hardware voltage guard or qualify worst-case4.2V regulation against battery actual allowed charge tolerance; neither established yet.
startup_review.termination_decision: Nominal1mA default is close to battery1.1mA reference, but published3mA/25C accuracy must not be reused to guarantee1mA across temperature.

candidate_operating_point.reason: Below explicit110mA max, avoids interpreting inconsistent standard-charge table.20mA charging time and1mA accuracy require verification.

startup_review.simplification_scope: Potentially remove external suspend latch only after watchdog and VIN-reconnect behavior verified. Keep external input limiter for startup. No BOM reduction claimed yet.
